edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (Nineteen Old Poems); the variant readings it marks are left out and punctuation is added at the source’s own phrase breaks.
edition.zh: 据维基文库《古诗十九首》，删去其所注异文，标点依原文断句补加。

basis.en: Anonymous Eastern Han poem, collected in the Wenxuan (c. 530).
basis.zh: 东汉无名氏诗，收于《文选》（约 530 年）。

note.en: The first of the Nineteen Old Poems, anonymous Eastern Han verses kept in the sixth-century anthology Wenxuan; they are the root of the five-character line that Tang poets would perfect. It is a poem of distance without blame. Notice the ending: after all the longing, the speaker sets it aside and says the plainest thing, ‘eat well’, which may be meant for the traveller or for the speaker, and is love either way.
note.zh: 《古诗十九首》的第一首。这组东汉无名氏的诗收在六世纪的《文选》里，是后来唐人五言诗的根。这是一首写离别而不怨人的诗。留意结尾：思念说尽之后，说话人把它放下，只说一句最平常的话，“努力加餐饭”，可能是嘱咐远行的人，也可能是说给自己，无论哪种都是爱。

excerpt.orig: 相去萬餘里，各在天一涯。
excerpt.en: Ten thousand li now lie between us, / each at one end of the sky.
excerpt.zh: 相去万余里，各在天一涯。

gloss.en: Parted while both are still alive. The Songs of Chu call it the greatest sorrow.
gloss.zh: 活生生地分离。《楚辞·九歌·少司命》：“悲莫悲兮生别离。”

gloss.en: More than ten thousand li. A li was a little over 400 metres in the Han; the number means unimaginably far.
gloss.zh: 里：古代长度单位，汉代一里约合今四百余米。万余里，极言其远。

gloss.en: Horses from the northern steppe lean into the north wind, and birds from Yue in the far south nest on southern boughs: even animals keep to home.
gloss.zh: 胡地的马依恋北风，越地的鸟在朝南的枝上筑巢，比喻眷恋故土。

gloss.en: Her sash grows looser each day: she is growing thin.
gloss.zh: 衣带一天比一天宽松，指人日渐消瘦。

gloss.en: Often read as a hint that something, or someone, has turned the traveller’s heart, as clouds hide the sun.
gloss.zh: 常被解作游子在外受了迷惑，如浮云遮住太阳。

gloss.en: A stock phrase in Han letters: take care of yourself, eat well. Some read it as said to herself.
gloss.zh: 汉代书信中常见的叮嘱语：保重，多吃饭。也有人认为是自我宽慰。

note.en: The first of the Nineteen Old Poems, at the root of the five-character line, ends its lament with ‘eat well’, a plain tenderness later poets rarely matched.
note.zh: 《古诗十九首》之首，五言诗的源头之一；满纸相思，却以“努力加餐饭”收住，这份朴素的深情后人难及。
